items.title: How boomers saw the light on property
items.description: After being rejected twice by an electorate that didn't want to give up lucrative tax arrangements on property, the Albanese government has sniffed the breeze and decided the time is ripe for change.

items.title: Live: Chalmers says Labor has chosen 'hard road of reform' in federal budget
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers says tonight's budget will be the government's most ambitious and will feature "more than the usual amount of savings and more than the usual amount of reform". Follow live.

items.title: Australian paratrooper killed after mid-air collision during training
items.description: Warrant Officer Class Two Lachlan Muddle, a highly qualified special forces sniper and military free-fall parachutist, has died after a mid-air collision with another paratrooper during an army training exercise.

items.title: Canvas developer Instructure says 'agreement' reached with hackers
items.description: The company at the centre of a cyber attack involving online learning platform Canvas, which is used right across Australia,  says it has reached an "agreement" with the hackers responsible.

items.title: Melbourne boy trapped under train had bag snagged by mirror, school says
items.description: The St Aloysius College student remains in a serious condition in hospital after the incident yesterday afternoon.

items.title: Controversial haka sees debate around anti-Indian racism come to a head in NZ
items.description: Indian communities across New Zealand say they are feeling "hounded" after a surge in racist incidents.

items.title: Trump, Xi and the AI race that could reshape global power
items.description: When Trump last visited China in 2017, artificial intelligence was not yet the centre of global power. Now it is.

items.title: Tough 24 hours ahead for Keir Starmer as doubters call for resignation
items.description: UK cabinet will meet today, local time, amid growing calls for Keir Starmer to set out an exit plan.

items.title: 'We are being attacked': Frantic call from a sailor to his family
items.description: As a peace deal between the US and Iran remains elusive, low-wage seafarers are in limbo as they witness an unprecedented 21st-century battle.

items.title: Carlton boss says Voss resignation proof club is in 'genuine transition'
items.description: Carlton CEO Graham Wright says the club will embark on a thorough process to determine the successor to Michael Voss.

items.title: Former soldier jailed for trafficking cocaine while in Australian Army
items.description: The Supreme Court of Queensland hears Cullen, a former infantry soldier, was sourcing ounces of cocaine and selling it to fellow soldiers while in the Australian Army.

items.title: 'Leaks in the urinals': Political journalism's backstory flushed out at Old Parliament House
items.description: The new Press Gallery exhibition takes visitors inside the original working spaces at Old Parliament House where reporters worked between 1927 and 1988.

items.title: Six passengers from hantavirus cruise ship 'in good health', minister says
items.description: Six passengers from a cruise ship at the centre of the deadly hantavirus outbreak are "in good health", as the Australian government remains hopeful it will finalise plans to repatriate them within 48 hours.

items.title: Four more ANU council members quit after Julie Bishop's shock resignation
items.description: The acting chancellor of the Australian National University confirms four more members of the university council have resigned, following last week's exit of former chancellor Julie Bishop.

items.title: My four-year break from booze has led to an unexpected discovery
items.description: What started out as abstinence during a pregnancy four years ago turned into a game with myself to see how long I could go without alcohol.

items.title: Inside the US blockbuster that brought $68 million to the Gold Coast
items.description: The $110 million Mortal Kombat sequel is the next in a laundry list of productions putting Queensland on the radar for international films.

items.title: More or less quiz: Follow the money and see what it gets you
items.description: A new quiz format? In this economy? Celebrate budget day with our More or Less challenge.

items.title: Delta Goodrem 'proud' to be at Eurovision as five nations boycott competition
items.description: This week, the Eurovision Song Contest will burst onto the stage in Vienna, and onto screens around the globe, but behind the colour and campness, this year's competition is shaping up as one of the most politically charged in history.

items.title: Bungled Spirits ferry replacement project cost $717m more than forecast
items.description: The Spirit of Tasmania ferry replacement program has cost $717 million more than was forecast in the original business case, a parliamentary inquiry has heard.

items.title: Family of Isla Bell left devastated as prosecutors drop murder charge
items.description: Melbourne man Marat Ganiev, who was accused of killing 19-year-old Isla Bell and putting her remains in a fridge, was due to face a Supreme Court trial this month.

items.title: Canberra teen charged with planning terrorist attack
items.description: The 17-year-old appeared in the ACT Children's Court today charged with one count of planning or preparing for a terrorist act and one count of transmitting violent extremist material.

items.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire on 'life support', with energy woes to continue
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he's aiming for "complete victory" in Iran as the US and Iran reach an impasse in negotiations.

items.title: Vanuatu drops limitations on China in key pact with Australia
items.description: The ABC can reveal that after months of difficult negotiations, the Nakamal Agreement has been approved by Vanuatu's cabinet but omits key limitations on China's influence.

items.title: Gout springs relay surprise as U20 world champs team named
items.description: Gout Gout is set to take part in the 200m and 4x400m relay at the Under-20 World Athletics Championships in August.

items.title: How Jess Pegula is rallying players in midst of French Open dispute
items.description: Jessica Pegula is putting her family experience of the NFL and NHL to use in tennis players' fight against the French Open for increased prize money.
